note: The Riverbrook half of Modern America's Riverbrook & Baker River in Rumney, on Route 25: a full-hookup grid in an open field with the office, lodge and pool. The Baker River sites and their river beach are across the road, and Campspot books both campgrounds on one listing. Mostly seasonal: about 40 of its roughly 85 sites are sold by the night. --Claude
summary: Operator site + Campspot API (types, per-site lengths, 2027 prices, minimums, season) + Google + Esri: 36 full-hookup 30/50 A RV sites and 4 tent sites sold nightly in Riverbrook; Standard $47 (spring weekdays) to $66 (July Saturday), Premium to $85, + $4 per stay; season ~May 13 to Oct 12, 2027. Price gate passes ($47). Google 4.7 (285). Mostly seasonal, nightly share ~45% (estimate) -> keep with caveat. Not waterfront confirmed.
flags: PRIVATE GATE: passes - cheapest RV night $47 before tax (Standard full-hookup, May weekdays 2027; $49 June weekdays) + the park's $4 per-stay booking fee (a one-night stay totals $51 with it). Summer peak: Standard $66, Pull-Thru $79, Premium $85 on Sat 2027-07-17 (2-night minimum). Not a Good Sam Park (cache isGsPark null); no gateway within 40 km. GOOGLE: 4.7 stars, 285 reviews ('Riverbrook Campground & RV Park'; the sister 'Baker River Campground, LLC' has its own listing, 3.3 from 13). RV Life stored 4 stars / $$$.

LONG-STAY (reviewer): nightly share ~45%, estimated, in the 10-50% band -> keep with caveat; note says 'Mostly seasonal'. Campspot sells 36 Riverbrook RV sites (Standard 22-40/48/49, Pull-Thru 14-21, Premium 04-12) plus 4 tent sites (T1-T4). Esri 230 m (spring, leaf-out) shows roughly 80-90 pads in the grid with ~45 units in place, the north and east rows carrying decks and sheds (seasonal look) while the west pull-through column stands empty. Operator: 'We offer many seasonal opportunities and discounts across our sites' (extended-stays page), but the home page leads with nightly full-hookup and tent sites and a booking engine. No standing minimum, no lot sales, no age rule. Pad count is an imagery estimate.
